stories.title: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
stories.body: The star said he was not responsible for Macklemore being dropped from the line-up after he made pro-Palestinian statements on stage.

stories.title: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
stories.body: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.

stories.title: What weapon could the US have put into space?
stories.body: The announcement by the US points to a developing field of modern warfare in the Earth's orbit.

stories.title: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
stories.body: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility.

stories.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
stories.body: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.

stories.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
stories.body: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".

stories.title: Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption
stories.body: Trains were cancelled or delayed on Tuesday after objects were found on tracks at multiple locations.

stories.title: Data centres and pipelines up for grabs as Carney pitches Canada to investment giants
stories.body: A $1tn sales pitch, more than 160 projects on offer, pivot to the EU amid a bitter trade war with the US - takeaways from the first Canada Investment Summit.

stories.title: Nigeria arrests alleged Mexican drug kingpin at international airport
stories.body: Arturo Carrera Loaiza denies allegations he was involved in meth production, the Nigerian authorities say.

stories.title: Ash from Mount Etna grounds flights at Sicily airport
stories.body: All flights are suspended from one of Italy's busiest airports until Tuesday night.

stories.title: More than 100,000 people in Japan are now aged 100 or older
stories.body: Figures show 88% of the centenarians are women as the population continues to age and shrink.

stories.title: British woman abducted in Malawi, police say
stories.body: The mother of two young children was kidnapped in the middle of the day in the main city, Blantyre.

stories.title: Colombian ex-foreign minister charged over nanny's lie detector test
stories.body: Laura Sarabia is accused of ordering police to interrogate her nanny after cash allegedly went missing from her flat.

stories.title: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys makes Emmy Awards history with double win
stories.body: He becomes the first person to win two lead acting prizes in one night at the prestigious TV ceremony.

stories.title: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace
stories.body: The origin of the drone is currently unknown, but authorities say it likely entered Lithuania from neighbouring Belarus, an ally of Russia.

stories.title: Donald Trump Jr and Bettina Trump say Putin ally paid for some wedding festivities as a 'gift'
stories.body: An Instagram post from the couple said two nights of their wedding festivities in the Bahamas were partially funded by Umar Kremlev.

stories.title: AI regulation faces political deadlock as calls grow for Congress to act
stories.body: With Trump opposed and Congress divided, new safety legislation on AI is unlikely to pass anytime soon despite mounting pressure.

stories.title: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie dies aged 87
stories.body: The "Sultan of Sequins" created iconic and dazzling costumes for stars including Cher, Tina Turner and Elton John.

stories.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
stories.body: Scientists say the record-breaking journey by three brothers offers hope wildlife can survive growing pressures.

stories.title: Satellite image reveals major damage that shut crucial Saudi oil pipeline
stories.body: Experts tell BBC Verify the pipeline's closure could cut oil supplies by as much as 3.6 million barrels per day.

Canada's infrastructure push aligns with broader trends in climate-resilient and tech-driven development, while Nigeria's anti-crime efforts signal a commitment to regional stability. However, contested signals like NATO's drone incident and sabotage in the Netherlands reveal persistent vulnerabilities in global security frameworks.

**4. What to watch next:**  
- **Canada's investment trajectory:** Monitor follow-through on Carney's pitch, particularly commitments from major players in data infrastructure and energy pipelines. This could signal a shift in global capital flows toward North America.  
- **Eastern European security dynamics:** Watch for further NATO actions or Russian responses that could escalate tensions.

The cautious mood reflects a world navigating opportunities amid persistent risks, with structural shifts in governance and investment taking shape against a backdrop of contested security narratives.
